P1_pytorch_product_state_entropy_zero.description: Pytorch: product state |+>⊗|+> has entanglement entropy S=0 — no correlations between subsystems

P2_pytorch_bell_state_entropy_log2.description: Pytorch: Bell state (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2) has S=log(2) — maximally entangled 2-qubit state

P3_pytorch_ghz_bipartition_entropy_log2.description: Pytorch: GHZ state qubit-1 vs (2,3) bipartition has S=log(2) — maximally entangled even in multipartite setting

P4_pytorch_w_state_entropy_between_0_and.description: Pytorch: W state qubit-1 bipartition has 0 < S < log(2) — different entanglement structure than GHZ

P5_sympy_bell_schmidt_entropy_log2.description: Sympy: Bell state reduced density matrix eigenvalues (1/2,1/2) give S=log(2) exactly

P6_sympy_product_state_rank1_reduced_den.description: Sympy: product state |+><+| is rank-1 with eigenvalue 1 — S = -1*log(1) = 0

P7_clifford_bell_state_has_grade2_conten.description: Clifford Cl(4,0): Bell state encoding has grade-2 bivector content — entanglement appears as cross-qubit bivector structure

P8_rustworkx_entanglement_graph_topology.description: Rustworkx: GHZ entanglement graph is 3-clique (3 equal edges); Bell is 1 edge — topology distinguishes multipartite from bipartite

N1_z3_unsat_separable_and_entropy_positi.description: Z3 UNSAT: state is fully separable AND entanglement entropy > 0 — by definition separable means S=0

N2_pytorch_product_state_zero_mutual_inf.description: Negative: product state has I(A:B)=0 — no correlations, consistent with S=0

N3_pytorch_bell_state_mutual_info_2log2.description: Negative: Bell state has I(A:B) = 2*log(2) — maximal bipartite correlation

N4_sympy_schmidt_rank_distinguishes_enta.description: Sympy: Bell state coefficient matrix rank=2 (entangled); product state rank=1 (separable) — Schmidt rank is the entanglement witness

N5_clifford_product_state_no_cross_mixin.description: Negative: product state e1*e3 has zero cross-qubit bivector components e14, e23 — no inter-qubit entanglement structure

N6_rustworkx_separable_isolated_nodes.description: Negative: entanglement graph with no edges has 2 isolated components — fully separable state, I(A:B)=0 for all pairs

N7_gudhi_two_entanglement_clusters.description: Negative Gudhi: two Bell pairs appear as 2 separate H0 clusters in entanglement filtration — bipartite entanglement has cluster structure

B1_pytorch_near_product_state_small_entr.description: Boundary: near-product state with epsilon entanglement has 0 < S << log(2) — entropy is continuous in state space

B2_sympy_entropy_boundary_at_pure_and_ma.description: Boundary sympy: S=0 at lambda=1 (pure/product), S=log(2) at lambda=1/2 (maximal) — entropy range [0, log(2)]

B3_pytorch_ghz_entropy_permutation_symme.description: Boundary: GHZ all single-qubit bipartitions have S=log(2) — GHZ is permutation-symmetric in entanglement

B4_z3_entangled_state_consistent.description: Boundary z3 SAT: S > 0 (entangled state) is consistent — entanglement exists

B5_rustworkx_complete_entanglement_graph.description: Boundary: complete 4-node entanglement graph has 6 edges — maximally multipartite entanglement topology

B6_gudhi_single_bell_pair_one_cluster.description: Boundary Gudhi: single strongly entangled Bell pair forms one H0 cluster — bipartite entanglement unifies both qubits
